thread:
maria gonzalez: FYI I opened a docs PR to add an offline KMS credential-rotation playbook for Private/VPC/on-prem installs. Includes redwoodctl examples + HSM notes but needs infra/security review. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821 :spiral_note_pad:

---

dan liu: Quick glance — the airgap tarball checksum link 404s (S3 path changed). I'll push a tiny link fix in the PR.

rajiv nair: We should call out nftables vs iptables ordering for the HSM host. In some distros the bridge/fwd chains break if nftables is active. Suggest adding one-liner to toggle: `sysctl -w net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables=0` and note persistent sysctl.

sophie chen: Also we need exact redwoodctl commands for bundle creation + verification for offline rotation. Draft snippet to include: ```bash
# generate rotation bundle
redwoodctl kms rotate --cluster my-cluster --out rotation-2026-03-21.tar.gz
# verify bundle locally (signature + manifest)
redwoodctl kms verify-signature --file rotation-2026-03-21.tar.gz
```

dan liu: small nit — the original PR used `redwoodctl kms verify` which is deprecated, `verify-signature` is correct, thanks. I'll update the examples and add a short note about exit codes for automation.

maria gonzalez: Good catch. Can someone add an explicit pkcs11 snippet for customers using HSMs (softHSM example accepted)? e.g. listing tokens so they can confirm module load.

rajiv nair: Adding pkcs11 example now: ```bash
# list tokens (SoftHSM2 example)
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so -L
# login + show objects
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so -l -O
```

infra-ci: CI check: docs lint ok, link-check found 1 broken url (the checksum).

maria gonzalez: For air-gapped installs please include the import command too: `redwoodctl import-bundle --file rotation-2026-03-21.tar.gz --offline` and a note about verifying signature offline with the bundled public key.

sophie chen: Drafting a short 'cluster rollout' checklist for the migration section: 1) drain runtime on node A 2) rotate creds on node A 3) restart serving runtime 4) validate KV cache misses/recover 5) un-drain, then repeat across nodes. Will add recommended wait times and a sample `kubectl drain` command.

dan liu: Also add a short troubleshooting subsection: common failure is missing CA on the HSM host (cert verify errors). Suggest adding `openssl s_client -connect <KMS_HOST>:443 -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt` as a diagnostic.

maria gonzalez: Nice. Can we also include a one-line network callout: for non-local KMS endpoints ensure egress TCP/443 to the KMS host and DNS resolution from the private subnet. Air-gap note: if using internal hostnames, document the /etc/hosts import step for installer bundles.

sophie chen: Will add both. Also adding a short paragraph about HSM token rotation ordering: rotate HSM client credentials first, then rotate runtime service keys to avoid brief authentication failures.

dan liu: tagging @security for final sign-off in the PR (they usually want the signature verification step explicit).

maria gonzalez: Thanks everyone — once @security signs off I'll merge. Action items: dan fix links + pkcs11 snippets, rajiv add nftables note, sophie add rollout checklist + offline import note.

docs-bot: PR 4821 status: docs lint passed ✅, link-check: pending (one broken link flagged)

maria gonzalez: I'll follow up next week after the security review. If anyone wants to add quick examples for other HSM vendors (Thales/Entrust) feel free to append to the PR. :thumbsup:
